test_case.test_name: Variant-bound BMC web KVM no-USB-hub live-video and safe-input validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the intended BMC KVM video and HID paths remain functional with the specified USB hub absent, producing the correct stable live console and one bounded harmless input response without unsafe controls or management faults.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and exclusion of same-code GB status
Exact hub absence definition plus no-hub video/HID topology and proof method
Correct-display, stability, latency and reconnect oracle with safe observation screen
One approved harmless keyboard/mouse action, credential handling, stop conditions and recovery
test_case.test_command: The authorized operator verifies the exact BMC/SUT and variant, records photo/inventory/topology proof that the specified USB hub is absent, launches one fresh BMC web KVM session with the approved client, records timestamped screenshots/video of the correct live host screen and stability/latency, performs the single approved harmless keyboard or pointer action on the safe screen, confirms the live response, then closes the session and preserves BMC/SEL/host events.
test_case.expected_result: The no-hub topology is independently proven; the authorized session shows the correct live SUT at the signed resolution/quality with acceptable stability and latency; the approved harmless input reaches only the intended safe target; the session closes cleanly with no prohibited control or BMC/host error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when composite identity, hub-absence proof, correct live visual evidence, signed stability/latency rubric and safe input response all match. Wrong/stale/blank/frozen image, excessive latency, input to the wrong target, missing response, session/BMC fault or any prohibited control is FAIL. Missing topology/client/rubric is BLOCKED at execution; login, reachability or launch alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until Source Key/Variant, exact hub absence/topology, authorized client/session, safe screen/input and visual/latency criteria are signed.
Protect credentials and session artifacts; verify exact BMC/SUT before login.
No power/reset, virtual media, firmware, shell or active-workload input, log clearing, automatic relaunch, reconnect or retry.
Stop on wrong host, stale/blank/frozen video, unexpected focus/input target, excessive latency, BMC instability or any unintended action.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 2039 GB Status
Diagram plus photo/inventory proving the specified USB hub is absent
Timestamped screenshots/video of correct live host display, resolution/quality, stability and latency
Approved harmless input action and visible response on the safe screen
Session launch/close, preserved BMC/SEL/host events, discrepancy/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong host, stale/blank/frozen video, unsafe focus/input or BMC fault, stop input immediately, close the session if safe and preserve evidence. Use only the signed operator-owned management recovery; do not issue power/reset/media actions, automatically relaunch or retry.
